description: Passes a random share of its eight inputs through to the matching outputs and silences the rest

params.text: Makes a fresh choice, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Sets the share of the connected inputs that is passed, 0 for none and 1 for all

inputs.text: A rising edge here makes a fresh choice of which inputs to pass
Sets the share of connected inputs that is passed, 0V to 10V read as 0 to 1, and overrides the probability knob while patched
One of the eight signals offered for selection; only connected inputs are counted in the draw

outputs.text: Carries the input on the same row while that row is chosen, and 0V while it is not; the green lamp beside it shows which

notes: nothing moves until the trigger jack rises or the button is pressed; before the first trigger every output is at 0V
the count that is passed is the number of connected inputs multiplied by the probability and rounded down, so four connected inputs at 0.5 pass two

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
